_comment: Two-tier plan v3 stage A1 (docs/2026-09-18_two_tier_plan_v3.zh.md §5.1, decisions §6 D1–D11): the NO-TOKEN executor's own axes — lookback L × segment Δ, the full grid, two seeds per cell, 40 arms. Every arm: plan_conditioning off (D10); seq_len = L / dt (D4); control_horizon_s = Δ and n_segments = Δ / 10 s (D6); the random-anchor future contract = Δ (one floor rule); NO anchor_floor_index, so the fixed anchor is L−1 = the first ask L seconds after entry (D2, D8's selection anchor); training anchors fully random, remaining-path-uniform, random_train_anchor_l1_share 0 (D7); executor recipe inherited from v2's L1c pa (D5: simple-v3 base, specific-force+path-angle + first-order-lag, imitation / heading-rate / bank-TV / final-time / endpoint terms off); 180 epochs without early stopping, lr 3e-5, batch 512, selection on the fixed-anchor common-grid ADE at L−1 (D8); split_seed 1337 pinned (D1: one by-flight split of all KRDU arrivals, shared by every cell and both seeds). ONE development cohort PER CELL (D1: a cell's usable set is the flights with L of lookback and Δ of truth after it, on both sides of the split; `run_ts.py plan_cohort --arms <this file>` writes all twenty from one load). File order = queue order (§8): Δ ascending, then L ascending, the two seeds together, so the short segments read first. No records ("predict": false): the readings are `manoeuvre_lockstep --protocol none` (§3.1: from L−1, and from the 12 / 8 / 6 km remaining-path bins, D3). The 09-18 campaign's three cells are NOT reused (§5.1). KRDU only, val split.
